note: LA.38. The GraphQL decorator nouns and the decorator-method field scan in parsers/code/extractors/src/graphql.rs run on every code file of every language and read `@Query(` / `@Resolver(` / `@ResolveField(` / `ObjectType):` / `@strawberry.type` anywhere: a Spring Data JPA `@Query("SELECT ...")` mints graphql_resolver:Query HANDLED_BY the repository method plus a FIELD resolver graphql_resolver:findPets, a NestJS REST controller's @nestjs/common `@Query()` parameter decorator mints graphql_resolver:Query, a Rust needle table mints Resolver / ResolveField / ObjectType / strawberry.type, and real NestJS / strawberry files mint the decorator names Resolver and strawberry.type as if they were GraphQL types. The family now runs only for TypeScript-family files importing @nestjs/graphql or type-graphql and Python files importing strawberry or graphene, at decorator / class position, and the noun is the root type the syntax declares (Query / Mutation / Subscription). server/recipes.resolver.ts and schema/schema.py are the controls. No cells binding: a precision guard.
